items.title: Google expands Gemini Live to some of its oldest smart speakers and displays
items.excerpt: Google is rolling out Gemini Live to first-generation Google Home Mini and Nest Hub hardware, letting years-old speakers hold free-form conversational sessions instead of one-shot commands.

items.title: Google Home's latest update tackles one of voice control's biggest annoyances
items.excerpt: Google Home's July update gives Gemini a 15-minute conversational memory, so follow-up smart-home commands no longer need to restate context.

items.title: OpenAI's first hardware device sounds half-speaker, half-robot
items.excerpt: OpenAI's debut hardware is reportedly a portable, screenless smart speaker meant to act as a humanlike physical manifestation of ChatGPT, controlling smart-home gear and media by voice alone.

items.title: Gemini Intelligence and Gemini Nano 4 launch with Galaxy Z Fold 8, Flip 8
items.excerpt: Samsung's new foldables are the first devices to ship Gemini Intelligence and the on-device Gemini Nano 4 model, which supports over 140 languages and improved multimodal understanding.

items.title: Gemini task automation expands to 40+ apps, Samsung shows off two more Android XR glasses
items.excerpt: Google expanded Gemini's agentic task automation from six apps to over 40 services across shopping, travel and dining, alongside two more Android XR glasses designs from Samsung.

items.title: Voicepilled Vibe Coders Are Drooling Over This Touchpad You Control With Your Tongue
items.excerpt: Augmental's MouthPad tongue-controlled trackpad and whisper-detecting mic were built as accessibility devices, but AI-first coders are adopting them as a hands-free input layer for agent workflows.

items.title: Framework Desktop packs Ryzen AI Max, up to 192GB of RAM, and local AI into a mini PC
items.excerpt: Framework's new Desktop pairs a Ryzen AI Max+ Pro 495 with up to 192GB of unified memory so creators can run frontier-class models like DeepSeek-V4-Flash entirely on a single local box.

items.title: This floating AI robot looks like it escaped a Studio Ghibli film, and that's exactly the point
items.excerpt: Keio University and MIT Media Lab researchers built Cuddle-Fish, a soft lighter-than-air companion robot that drifts silently through the home - a deliberate design rebuttal to noisy, hard-shelled home robots.

items.title: Samsung's humanoid ambitions are real, but factories come first
items.excerpt: Samsung stood up a new RX robotics division that will target factory humanoids before consumer machines, setting expectations for when embodied AI actually reaches the home.

items.title: Samsung Unveils More Smart Glasses Designs from Gentle Monster & Warby Parker Ahead of Fall Release
items.excerpt: Samsung showed four Gentle Monster and Warby Parker frames at Unpacked in London - all shipping this fall as effectively the first consumer glasses running Google's Android XR.

items.title: iOS 27 public beta 2 is here with Siri AI, iPhone speed upgrades, and more
items.excerpt: Apple pushed iOS 27 public beta 2 with the rebuilt Siri AI powered by new on-device Apple Foundation Models, plus systemwide performance work ahead of the fall release.

items.title: Samsung unveils AI smart glasses powered by Android XR
items.excerpt: Samsung's Intelligent Eyewear runs Android XR on a Snapdragon AR1 Gen 1 with Gemini built in, deliberately shipping without a display so the interface is audio and voice first.

items.title: Eyes-on: First look at the Samsung Gentle Monster and Warby Parker smart glasses
items.excerpt: A hands-on with Samsung's fashion-house AI eyewear: both frames run Android XR with no internal screens, so nothing clutters your sight line and everything happens through Gemini's voice layer.

items.title: Ultrahuman overhauls its app, brings all of its analysis on-device
items.excerpt: Ultrahuman's redesigned Emerald app simplifies the interface and moves all health analysis onto the ring itself, so its AI insights keep working with no internet connection.

items.title: Instagram is now banning users who make creepy content with Meta glasses
items.excerpt: Instagram has started removing accounts that use Meta's camera glasses to covertly film strangers, drawing the first hard platform line around always-on AI eyewear capture.

items.title: macOS 27 Beta Reveals Hidden Siri 'Voice Pad' Interface
items.excerpt: A hidden macOS 27 interface lets you pick Siri's voice from an interactive spatial-audio grid of up to 13 American English voices that responds as the cursor moves.

items.title: Apple Store App Getting AI Shopping Assistant
items.excerpt: Apple's updated privacy policy reveals a virtual shopping assistant coming to the Apple Store app, using account, device and location context to recommend hardware through a chat interface.

items.title: Honor Robot Phone leaked hands-on video shows thickness, camera gimbal in action
items.excerpt: A leaked hands-on shows Honor's Robot Phone motorized gimbal arm repositioning itself to track subjects - an AI camera that physically moves rather than cropping in software.

items.title: Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Flip 8 use AI to turn group videos into personal fan cams
items.excerpt: My FanCam is a new Galaxy AI feature that reprocesses saved group videos in the Gallery app, tracking a chosen subject and re-centering the frame into a personal cut.
